# Polishing & Buffing

Polishing follows finishing: buffing wheels charged with compound remove fine scratches and raise the surface to a bright or mirror finish. Tell us your material, current process and target finish, and we will recommend the right wheel and compound sequence.

## Recommended products

- [Buffing & Polishing Wheels](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/buffing-wheels.md): Airway, bias and stitched buffing wheels for cutting and colouring with polishing compounds.
